title: ROAD//ZERO
models: OpenAI built-in image generation (process-only reference images)
own_art_list: All shipped 3D geometry is original Three.js code produced through the 404 recipe; UI is original CSS; concept frames are process-only generated references and are not shipped as game textures.
what_i_found: A compact championship racer built around three persistent rivals with readable driving personalities: the Charger attacks and overcommits, the Technician protects a clean optimal line, and the Defender covers position. Across Orchard, Quarry, and Summit races, the player learns who is nearby and adapts each overtake rather than racing three identical bots.
